Hi, I’m Guido. I’ve always been curious about why people choose what they choose, and about the small details that make a brand feel real the moment you walk into a space. That curiosity took me from studying in Florence and Rome to working on stores and events in Milan. This is my story so far, and the projects I’ve worked on along the way.

About

I’m a marketing and communication specialist working across retail, events and content. At Samsung Electronics Italia I manage in-store projects, budgets and suppliers, and organise corporate events and trainings in line with global brand guidelines.

My background is in business and marketing: a Bachelor’s in Business Administration from the University of Florence and a Master’s in Marketing from LUISS (110/110), where I also support the Digital Media Economics course as Subject Matter Expert. At Sanofi I worked on Dupixent communication and medical congresses. Outside work, I follow gaming, UI/UX and technology.
